faqs.a: Pick an outfit, choose your dates and pay securely online. You pay the rent, a 12% service fee, the cleaning fee and a small damage protection fee, all shown before you pay. Then collect the outfit from us or get it delivered locally at cost.

faqs.q: What if my outfit doesn't fit?
faqs.a: Every listing shows its size and measurements. Message us on WhatsApp before booking if you want to double-check, and you can try it on when you collect it.
No. Instead you pay a small, non-refundable damage protection fee that covers everyday accidents like minor stains, loose threads and lost buttons.
Yes. Cancel 72 hours or more before pickup for a full refund of the rent, or between 72 and 24 hours for half. Within 24 hours the rent isn't refunded. The service fee is never refunded.

faqs.q: What happens if something gets damaged?
faqs.a: Minor damage is covered by the protection fee. For serious damage or loss, you pay the repair cost, or the outfit's value if it can't be repaired. We film every outfit at handover and at return, so it's clear to both sides.

faqs.q: How much can I earn as a lender?
faqs.a: You keep 100% of the price you set. Renters pay our service fee on top. You're paid once the outfit is back and checked, and we handle payments, handover and cleaning.
